{{Quote|One of the speeders that was attacked belonged to an admiral. She escaped serious injury, but the situation demands immediate action.|Commander Rilan|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''admiral''' served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war, her [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was attacked by [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] beasts between the [[Dromund Kaas spaceport]] and [[Kaas City]], on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rilan]] cited the incident with the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] as one of the reasons behind investigation into what was stirring up the wildlife.<ref name="TOR" />
